{"scenes":[{"id":"scene_flow_route","component":"flow_diagram","props":{"nodes":[{"id":"sender","label":"发送端"},{"id":"channel","label":"通信信道"},{"id":"receiver","label":"接收端"}],"edges":[{"id":"sender_to_channel","from":"sender","to":"channel"},{"id":"channel_to_receiver","from":"channel","to":"receiver"}],"paths":[{"id":"main_path","edge_ids":["sender_to_channel","channel_to_receiver"]}]},"narration_segment_ids":["n1"],"purpose":"用流程图展示发送端、通信信道和接收端，并激活从发送端到接收端的主路径，对应旁白中信息传输的基本链路。","visual_intent":{"viewer_understands":"信息从发送端出发，经过通信信道到达接收端。","before":"画面中只有空的流程区域，尚未出现任何节点或连线。","after":"发送端、通信信道、接收端三个节点依次出现，主路径被点亮，显示信息从发送端经信道流向接收端。"},"beats":[{"id":"s1_reveal_scene","action":"reveal","target_id":"scene","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"start","offset_ms":0}},{"id":"s1_reveal_sender","action":"reveal","target_id":"node:sender","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"start","offset_ms":200}},{"id":"s1_reveal_channel","action":"reveal","target_id":"node:channel","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"start","offset_ms":400}},{"id":"s1_reveal_receiver","action":"reveal","target_id":"node:receiver","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"start","offset_ms":600}},{"id":"s1_reveal_edge1","action":"reveal","target_id":"edge:sender_to_channel","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"end","offset_ms":-700}},{"id":"s1_reveal_edge2","action":"reveal","target_id":"edge:channel_to_receiver","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"end","offset_ms":-400}},{"id":"s1_activate_path","action":"activate_path","target_id":"path:main_path","trigger":{"segment_id":"n1","boundary":"end","offset_ms":0}}]},{"id":"scene_noise_concept","component":"concept_reveal","props":{"title":"通信噪声","lines":["传输过程中对信号的干扰"]},"narration_segment_ids":["n2"],"purpose":"解释通信噪声是传输过程中对信号的干扰，建立噪声的概念。","visual_intent":{"viewer_understands":"通信噪声发生在传输过程中，并且是对信号的干扰。","before":"画面尚未出现噪声概念的文字说明。","after":"标题“通信噪声”和说明行“传输过程中对信号的干扰”显示出来。"},"beats":[{"id":"s2_reveal_scene","action":"reveal","target_id":"scene","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":0}},{"id":"s2_reveal_title","action":"reveal","target_id":"title","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":300}},{"id":"s2_reveal_line","action":"reveal","target_id":"line:1","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"start","offset_ms":700}},{"id":"s2_highlight_title","action":"highlight","target_id":"title","trigger":{"segment_id":"n2","boundary":"end","offset_ms":0}}]},{"id":"scene_noise_impact","component":"flow_diagram","props":{"nodes":[{"id":"sender","label":"发送端"},{"id":"channel","label":"通信信道"},{"id":"receiver","label":"接收端"},{"id":"noise","label":"通信噪声"}],"edges":[{"id":"sender_to_channel","from":"sender","to":"channel"},{"id":"channel_to_receiver","from":"channel","to":"receiver"},{"id":"noise_to_channel","from":"noise","to":"channel"}],"paths":[{"id":"main_path","edge_ids":["sender_to_channel","channel_to_receiver"]}]},"narration_segment_ids":["n3"],"purpose":"在流程图上引入噪声节点，标记信道受扰，并突出接收端可能收到不同信息的状态变化。","visual_intent":{"viewer_understands":"噪声作用在信道上，使传输过程受到干扰，接收端收到的信息可能与发送端发出的不同。","before":"流程图上只有发送端、信道、接收端和主路径，没有噪声节点，信道边未被标记受扰。","after":"噪声节点和噪声到信道的连线出现，信道到接收端的边被标记为受扰，接收端被高亮，表现可能出现的差异。"},"beats":[{"id":"s3_reveal_scene","action":"reveal","target_id":"scene","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"start","offset_ms":0}},{"id":"s3_reveal_noise","action":"reveal","target_id":"node:noise","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"start","offset_ms":400}},{"id":"s3_reveal_noise_edge","action":"reveal","target_id":"edge:noise_to_channel","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"start","offset_ms":800}},{"id":"s3_mark_disrupted","action":"mark_disrupted","target_id":"edge:channel_to_receiver","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"end","offset_ms":-500}},{"id":"s3_highlight_receiver","action":"highlight","target_id":"node:receiver","trigger":{"segment_id":"n3","boundary":"end","offset_ms":0}}]},{"id":"scene_not_always_error","component":"comparison","props":{"left":{"label":"噪声的影响","items":["可能使接收信息与发送不同"]},"right":{"label":"实际情况","items":["不表示每次传输都会出错"]},"highlights":["可能出错 ≠ 每次出错"]},"narration_segment_ids":["n4"],"purpose":"对比噪声带来差错的可能性与“每次都会出错”的误解，澄清噪声不等于每次传输都出错。","visual_intent":{"viewer_understands":"噪声可能带来差错，但不表示每次传输都会出错。","before":"画面尚未呈现噪声影响与实际情况的对比。","after":"左侧显示噪声可能使接收信息不同，右侧显示不表示每次传输都会出错，差异被强调。"},"beats":[{"id":"s4_reveal_scene","action":"reveal","target_id":"scene","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"start","offset_ms":0}},{"id":"s4_reveal_left","action":"reveal","target_id":"side:left","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"start","offset_ms":400}},{"id":"s4_reveal_right","action":"reveal","target_id":"side:right","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"start","offset_ms":800}},{"id":"s4_emphasize_diff","action":"emphasize_difference","target_id":"diff","trigger":{"segment_id":"n4","boundary":"end","offset_ms":0}}]}]}
